W water · F fertilize · P colour

Controls (H to hide)

Mouse

  • Drag — orbit camera
  • Right-drag — pan
  • Wheel — zoom
  • Hover — highlight plant
  • Click plant — select
  • Double-click plant — water
  • Click lamp — toggle light
  • Click can — water selected
  • Click swatch — change colour
  • Day/Night button — toggle

Keyboard

  • 1–5 / Tab select plant
  • W water · F fertilize · D dry out
  • L lamp · G glow light
  • N toggle day/night · T freeze time
  • P plant colour · Shift+P all plants
  • [ ] scrub time of day
  • ↑ ↓ wind strength
  • ← → orbit · + − zoom
  • C reset camera · Space pause
